name: Playgama
tagline: Publish and manage HTML5 games on Playgama without leaving your editor
description: Playgama hosts HTML5 games. This remote server puts the Playgama developer cabinet behind MCP, so the agent creates a game and fills in its form, uploads a build and polls until the engine analysis finishes, uploads covers in the exact sizes the form requires, edits the in-app catalog and leaderboards, gets a QA Tool link, and publishes a sandbox - a public link anyone can play. 20 tools, 10 of them read-only; submitting to moderation, deleting and payouts stay manual. A free token is issued at developer.playgama.com/mcp.
